name: Alta LinkedIn Door
called_by: the Grok Bot Inbox, over one scoped key on the X-Inbox-Key header
description: The only way anything outside n8n works an Alta LinkedIn conversation. Three actions on one webhook: get_thread rebuilds a prospect's conversation from Alta, get_prospect answers the dossier, send_reply sends one LinkedIn message after a human said yes. The Alta OAuth tokens never leave n8n, every send writes a Hub Automations row, and nothing else on the instance is reachable through it.
